Name: Accumulator
Description: 从场景中可用节点累积特定类型的图，例如水、森林或雪。

Flubs.Name: SnowMask
Flubs.Description: Accumulate all snow as a flat mask.

Flubs.Name: SnowDepth
Flubs.Description: Accumulate all Snow Depth at absolute values.

Flubs.Name: Rivers
Flubs.Description: Accumulate all rivers.

Flubs.Name: WaterMask
Flubs.Description: Accumulate all water as a flat mask.

Flubs.Name: WaterDepth
Flubs.Description: Accumulate all Water Depth in absolute values.

Flubs.Name: ShoreMask
Flubs.Description: Accumulate all Shore masks.

Flubs.Name: DebrisMask
Flubs.Description: Accumulate all DebrisMask (using Max mode)

Flubs.Name: DebrisColor
Flubs.Description: Accumulate just the DebrisColor (using Max mode).

Flubs.Name: Trees
Flubs.Description: Accumulate all trees generated by Trees and Shrubs nodes.

Flubs.Name: TreeDeadZones
Flubs.Description: Accumulate all dead zones in Trees nodes.

Flubs.Name: TreeFreshwater
Flubs.Description: Accumulate all fresh water flows from Tree nodes.

Flubs.Name: Restrict to Group
Flubs.Description: Restricts accumulating from other nodes that are in the same Group as the Accumulator node.

Name: Adjust
Description: 将常用高度/数值调整集中在一个节点中，并可单独开关各项处理（又称 Fx）。

Flubs.Name: Multiply
Flubs.Description: 将每个值乘以指定系数。

Flubs.Name: Shaper
Flubs.Description: 用塑形函数改变数值曲线。

Flubs.Name: Clamp
Flubs.Description: 将数值限制在指定最小/最大范围。

Flubs.Name: Clip
Flubs.Description: 裁切超出给定范围的数值。

Flubs.Name: Drop
Flubs.Description: 按阈值丢弃偏低或偏高的值。

Flubs.Name: Autolevel
Flubs.Description: 自动拉伸数值以占满可用输出范围。

Flubs.Name: Equalize
Flubs.Description: Redistributes values to achieve a more uniform distribution.

Flubs.Name: Strong
Flubs.Description: Enhances the contrast or intensity of values.

Flubs.Name: Invert
Flubs.Description: Flips values to their opposite within the range.

Name: Anastomosis
Description: 模拟辫状/网状水系连通结构。

Flubs.Name: Impact
Flubs.Description: The intensity of the process. Higher values create stronger physical impacts within the erosion process.

Flubs.Name: Width
Flubs.Description: Controls the horizontal spread of the anastomosis effect. Larger values produce wider channels and features.

Flubs.Name: Depth
Flubs.Description: Determines the vertical extent of the erosion. Higher values result in deeper cuts and more pronounced terrain features.

Flubs.Name: Downcutting
Flubs.Description: Specifies the style and aggressiveness of vertical erosion. Select from various modes to control how the terrain is carved downward.

Flubs.Name: Destructive
Flubs.Description: Applies aggressive downcutting, rapidly eroding and deepening channels.

Flubs.Name: Pits
Flubs.Description: Focuses erosion into localized depressions, creating pit-like features.

Flubs.Name: Flows
Flubs.Description: Simulates water flow erosion, carving smooth, continuous channels.

Flubs.Name: Rivers
Flubs.Description: Emphasizes river-like downcutting, forming distinct riverbeds.

Flubs.Name: Riversx2
Flubs.Description: Doubles the intensity of river downcutting for deeper, more defined riverbeds.

Flubs.Name: Riversx4
Flubs.Description: Quadruples the river downcutting effect, producing extremely deep and prominent river channels.

Flubs.Name: Flooding
Flubs.Description: Simulates broad, shallow erosion typical of flooding events.

Flubs.Name: Floodingx2
Flubs.Description: Doubles the flooding effect, increasing the area and depth of flood erosion.

Flubs.Name: Flooding_x4
Flubs.Description: Quadruples the flooding effect, creating extensive and deep flood-eroded regions.

Flubs.Name: Quality
Flubs.Description: Sets the processing resolution for the node. Higher quality yields more detailed results at the cost of performance.

Flubs.Name: Quarter
Flubs.Description: Processes at 1/4 resolution for fastest performance and lowest detail.

Flubs.Name: Third
Flubs.Description: Processes at 1/3 resolution, balancing speed and detail.

Flubs.Name: Half
Flubs.Description: Processes at 1/2 resolution for moderate detail and performance.

Flubs.Name: Full
Flubs.Description: Processes at full resolution for maximum detail and slower performance.

Flubs.Name: Smooth Edges
Flubs.Description: Softens the edges of eroded features, reducing sharp transitions and creating a more natural appearance.

Name: Angle
Description: 按朝向/角度条件生成遮罩或影响。

Flubs.Name: Azimuth
Flubs.Description: The direction from which to start the selection.

Flubs.Name: Falloff
Flubs.Description: The soft falloff at the maximum angle.

Name: AO
Description: 环境光遮蔽（Ambient Occlusion），增强凹处阴影感。

Flubs.Name: Quality
Flubs.Description: Sets the processing resolution for the ambient occlusion calculation. Higher quality provides more accurate and detailed results, but may increase computation time.

Flubs.Name: Low
Flubs.Description: Fastest processing with minimal detail. Suitable for previews or low-fidelity outputs.

Flubs.Name: Medium
Flubs.Description: Balanced processing speed and detail. Recommended for general use.

Flubs.Name: High
Flubs.Description: High detail with slower processing. Use when fine ambient occlusion is required.

Flubs.Name: Ultra
Flubs.Description: Maximum detail and accuracy. Best for final renders, but slowest to compute.

Flubs.Name: Enhance
Flubs.Description: Boosts the strength and clarity of the ambient occlusion effect, making shadows and depth more pronounced in the terrain.

Name: Aperture
Description: 光圈/开口相关控制，用于局部通行或造型。

Flubs.Name: Information
Flubs.Description: Displays additional information or metadata about the aperture operation and its current settings.

Flubs.Name: Mode
Flubs.Description: Specifies the morphological operation to apply to the input, affecting how features are expanded or contracted.

Flubs.Name: Dilation
Flubs.Description: Expands or grows features in the input by the specified shape and size, filling small holes and connecting nearby elements.

Flubs.Name: Erosion
Flubs.Description: Contracts or shrinks features in the input by the specified shape and size, removing small details and separating connected elements.

Flubs.Name: Size
Flubs.Description: Sets the size of the structuring element (aperture) used for the operation. Larger values increase the effect's reach.

Flubs.Name: Shape
Flubs.Description: Determines the geometric shape of the structuring element used for dilation or erosion, affecting the style of the transformation.

Flubs.Name: Disk
Flubs.Description: Uses a circular (disk-shaped) structuring element for smooth, rounded transformations.

Flubs.Name: Polygon
Flubs.Description: Uses a regular polygon as the structuring element, allowing for custom-sided shapes.

Flubs.Name: Asterisk
Flubs.Description: Uses a star or asterisk-shaped structuring element, emphasizing cross-like or radiating effects.

Flubs.Name: Line
Flubs.Description: Uses a straight line as the structuring element, applying the effect directionally.

Flubs.Name: Corner
Flubs.Description: Uses a corner-shaped structuring element, targeting angular or edge features.

Flubs.Name: Vertices Count
Flubs.Description: For polygon shapes, sets the number of vertices (sides) used, controlling the regularity and appearance of the structuring element.

Flubs.Name: Corner Angle
Flubs.Description: Specifies the angle of the corner for the 'Corner' shape, adjusting the sharpness or openness of the structuring element.

Flubs.Name: Direction
Flubs.Description: Sets the orientation or direction for directional shapes (such as Line or Asterisk), controlling the angle of the effect.

Flubs.Name: Antialiased
Flubs.Description: If enabled, applies antialiasing to the aperture operation, smoothing the edges of the transformed features for a cleaner result.

Name: Autolevel
Description: 自动将输入重映射，以占满可用的高度或遮罩范围。

Name: BlobRemover
Description: 移除孤立斑块/碎块，清理遮罩或地形噪点。

Flubs.Name: Range
Flubs.Description: Controls the sensitivity of the blob detection. Higher values detect a wider range of blob sizes or intensities.

Flubs.Name: Connectivity
Flubs.Description: Specifies how connected blobs must be to be considered a single shape. Higher connectivity allows blobs to be more loosely attached to larger shapes.

Flubs.Name: Enforce Quantization
Flubs.Description: If enabled, forces the use of quantization during blob detection, improving efficiency and consistency in identifying blobs.

Flubs.Name: Quantization
Flubs.Description: Sets the quantization level for blob detection, with values between 1 and 128. Lower values provide finer detail, while higher values group similar values together for faster and more efficient blob identification.

Name: Blur
Description: Blur 扩散锐利形状并软化地形。

Name: Bomber
Description: 在地形上散布/“轰炸”放置多种细节或实例效果。

Flubs.Name: Iterations
Flubs.Description: Number of instances the bombing operation will create. Higher values increase the number of scattered elements.

Flubs.Name: Multiplier
Flubs.Description: Quickly multiply the number of bombed instances by increasing or decreasing this value, scaling the overall density.

Flubs.Name: Size
Flubs.Description: The minimum and maximum relative size of bombed instances, allowing for variation in the scale of each element.

Flubs.Name: Size Distribution
Flubs.Description: Controls the uniformity of the size of bombed instances. Higher values produce more consistent sizes, while lower values allow greater variation.

Flubs.Name: Rotation
Flubs.Description: The minimum and maximum range of rotations for the bombed instances, introducing random orientation for each element.

Flubs.Name: Proportional
Flubs.Description: Determines whether instances should maintain height-to-size proportion. When enabled, scaling an instance will also scale its height proportionally.

Flubs.Name: Variable Height
Flubs.Description: Allows variations in the height of bombed instances, introducing additional randomness to their elevation.

Flubs.Name: Height
Flubs.Description: The minimum and maximum range of height variations for the bombed instances, controlling how tall or flat each element can be.

Flubs.Name: Distribution
Flubs.Description: The method used to distribute bombed instances across the surface.

Flubs.Name: Random
Flubs.Description: A randomized distribution that results in pure chaotic patterns, scattering instances unpredictably.

Flubs.Name: Grid
Flubs.Description: A normalized grid distribution function that results in a systematic, evenly spaced pattern.

Flubs.Name: Jitter
Flubs.Description: The random offset applied to each instance while distributing, adding natural variation to their placement.

Flubs.Name: Seed
Flubs.Description: The randomization pattern or seed for the node's process. Changing the seed produces different distribution patterns.

Flubs.Name: Fade Edges
Flubs.Description: Softens the edges of bombed instances, blending them more smoothly into the base terrain.

Flubs.Name: Blend Mode
Flubs.Description: Specifies how the base terrain and bombed instances are merged together.

Flubs.Name: None
Flubs.Description: Each instance overwrites the underlying terrain at its location.

Flubs.Name: Blend
Flubs.Description: Blends instances with the base terrain using standard blending.

Flubs.Name: Add
Flubs.Description: Adds the height values of instances on top of the base terrain.

Flubs.Name: Subtract
Flubs.Description: Subtracts each instance from the base and previous instances, creating depressions.

Flubs.Name: Difference
Flubs.Description: Creates a difference between the base and each bombed instance, emphasizing changes.

Flubs.Name: Multiply
Flubs.Description: Multiplies the base terrain with each bombed instance, modulating the result.

Flubs.Name: Screen
Flubs.Description: Adds the two inputs without overexposing the output, resulting in a lighter blend.

Flubs.Name: Max
Flubs.Description: Retains the maximum height values of each bombed instance and the base terrain.

Flubs.Name: Min
Flubs.Description: Retains the minimum height values of each bombed instance and the base terrain.

Flubs.Name: Quality
Flubs.Description: The level of quality to be used for the bombing operation. Draft is recommended for high-resolution previews, while Medium and High provide better final results.

Flubs.Name: Draft
Flubs.Description: Fastest processing with lower quality, suitable for previews.

Flubs.Name: Medium
Flubs.Description: Balanced quality and performance for general use.

Flubs.Name: High
Flubs.Description: Highest quality with the most detail, recommended for final output.

Flubs.Name: Add Input
Flubs.Description: Allows an additional input to be included in the bombing operation, enabling more complex or layered effects.

Name: Bulbous
Description: 生成圆鼓、块状的岩石/地貌体量。

Name: Canyon
Description: 快速且细致的峡谷基础体：基于排水生成河谷型峡谷。

Flubs.Name: Structure
Flubs.Description: 峡谷造型模型，影响形态与壁面特征。

Flubs.Name: Style
Flubs.Description: 峡谷造型模型，影响形态与壁面特征。

Flubs.Name: Classic
Flubs.Description: 干净、程序化的切削剖面。

Flubs.Name: Eroded
Flubs.Description: 增加侵蚀破碎与自然不规则感。

Flubs.Name: Eroded2
Flubs.Description: 更丰富的壁面细节与侵蚀感。

Flubs.Name: Strata
Flubs.Description: Introduces stratified, layered wall features resembling sedimentary rock bands.

Flubs.Name: Both
Flubs.Description: Combines erosion breakup with stratified layering for a layered-and-worn look.

Flubs.Name: Scale
Flubs.Description: 峡谷尺度。

Flubs.Name: Slot
Flubs.Description: 窄缝峡谷成分：更深切缝的紧度与强调。

Flubs.Name: Valley
Flubs.Description: 更宽阔的谷地形态。

Flubs.Name: Surrounding
Flubs.Description: 峡谷与周围地形的融合程度。

Flubs.Name: Depth
Flubs.Description: The depth of the canyon.

Flubs.Name: Structual Warp
Flubs.Description: Applies large-scale warping to the canyon structure to introduce bends, meanders, and macro variation.

Flubs.Name: Seed
Flubs.Description: The randomization pattern or seed for the node's process.

Flubs.Name: Formation
Flubs.Description: Applies finer warping to add small-scale distortion and surface complexity without changing the overall canyon layout.

Flubs.Name: Detail Warp
Flubs.Description: Applies finer warping to add small-scale distortion and surface complexity without changing the overall canyon layout.

Flubs.Name: Alternate Style
Flubs.Description: Introduces a secondary variation of the selected style to break uniformity and add visual diversity.

Name: Cartography
Description: 制图风格处理，用于地图化表现。

Flubs.Name: Map Style
Flubs.Description: Controls the precision of map features such as contours and gradients. Higher values produce more detailed and accurate representations of terrain.

Flubs.Name: Accuracy
Flubs.Description: Controls the precision of map features such as contours and gradients. Higher values produce more detailed and accurate representations of terrain.

Flubs.Name: Gradient Style
Flubs.Description: Specifies the style of gradient used to represent elevation or terrain features on the map.

Flubs.Name: Smooth
Flubs.Description: Applies a continuous, smooth gradient for a natural transition between elevation bands.

Flubs.Name: LargeContours
Flubs.Description: Emphasizes major elevation bands with broad, distinct contour regions.

Flubs.Name: AllContours
Flubs.Description: Displays all contour lines, including minor and major bands, for maximum detail.

Flubs.Name: Equalize Gradient
Flubs.Description: Balances the gradient distribution to ensure even representation of elevation changes across the map.

Flubs.Name: Reverse
Flubs.Description: Inverts the color or gradient mapping, swapping high and low elevation colors for a different visual effect.

Flubs.Name: Erode
Flubs.Description: Applies an erosion effect to the map, softening features and simulating natural terrain wear.

Flubs.Name: Land
Flubs.Description: Selects the color palette used for land areas on the map.

Flubs.Name: Land Palette
Flubs.Description: Selects the color palette used for land areas on the map.

Flubs.Name: Classic
Flubs.Description: Uses a traditional cartographic color scheme for land.

Flubs.Name: Minimal
Flubs.Description: Applies a minimalistic color palette for a clean, modern look.

Flubs.Name: FertileRed
Flubs.Description: Highlights fertile areas with red tones.

Flubs.Name: FertileGreen
Flubs.Description: Highlights fertile areas with green tones.

Flubs.Name: RedBlueSpectrum
Flubs.Description: Uses a spectrum from red to blue to represent elevation or land type.

Flubs.Name: MineralsYellow
Flubs.Description: Emphasizes mineral-rich areas with yellow hues.

Flubs.Name: FertileCool
Flubs.Description: Applies cool tones to fertile regions for a subdued effect.

Flubs.Name: FertileMurky
Flubs.Description: Uses murky, earthy tones to represent fertile land.

Flubs.Name: Land Contours
Flubs.Description: Controls the visibility and density of contour lines on land areas, highlighting elevation changes.

Flubs.Name: Land Contour Intenstity
Flubs.Description: Adjusts the brightness or opacity of land contour lines, making them more or less prominent.

Flubs.Name: Land Bias
Flubs.Description: Applies a bias to the land color or contour mapping, shifting emphasis to certain elevation ranges or features.

Flubs.Name: Water Palette
Flubs.Description: Selects the color palette used for water areas on the map.

Flubs.Name: Classic
Flubs.Description: Uses a traditional blue color scheme for water.

Flubs.Name: BlackSea
Flubs.Description: Applies a dark, deep blue palette reminiscent of the Black Sea.

Flubs.Name: Caribbean
Flubs.Description: Uses bright, turquoise tones inspired by Caribbean waters.

Flubs.Name: Water Contours
Flubs.Description: Controls the visibility and density of contour lines in water areas, indicating depth or underwater features.

Flubs.Name: Water Contour Intenstity
Flubs.Description: Adjusts the brightness or opacity of water contour lines, making them more or less prominent.

Flubs.Name: Water Bias
Flubs.Description: Applies a bias to the water color or contour mapping, shifting emphasis to certain depth ranges or features.

Flubs.Name: Trim
Flubs.Description: Removes or crops map features outside a specified boundary, focusing the map on a particular region.

Flubs.Name: Line Art
Flubs.Description: Sets the number of grid divisions overlaid on the map, controlling the density of the grid.

Flubs.Name: Grid Count
Flubs.Description: Sets the number of grid divisions overlaid on the map, controlling the density of the grid.

Flubs.Name: Grid Intenstity
Flubs.Description: Adjusts the brightness or opacity of the grid lines, making them more or less visible.

Flubs.Name: Grid Style
Flubs.Description: Specifies where grid lines are drawn on the map.

Flubs.Name: None
Flubs.Description: No grid lines are displayed.

Flubs.Name: OverWater
Flubs.Description: Grid lines are drawn only over water areas.

Flubs.Name: OverLand
Flubs.Description: Grid lines are drawn only over land areas.

Flubs.Name: Everywhere
Flubs.Description: Grid lines are drawn over both land and water areas.

Flubs.Name: Boundary Thickness
Flubs.Description: Sets the thickness of boundary lines, such as map borders or region outlines.

Flubs.Name: Contour Thickness
Flubs.Description: Specifies the thickness of contour lines, affecting their visual prominence.

Flubs.Name: Grid Thickness
Flubs.Description: Controls the thickness of grid lines overlaid on the map.

Name: Cellular
Description: 蜂窝/细胞噪声，适合岩石破裂与斑块状分布。

Flubs.Name: Size
Flubs.Description: Controls the overall scale of the cellular pattern. Higher values produce smaller cells (finer detail); lower values produce larger cells (coarser detail).

Flubs.Name: Density
Flubs.Description: Controls how many feature points are generated per area. Higher density creates more, smaller cells; lower density creates fewer, larger cells.

Flubs.Name: Jitter
Flubs.Description: Randomizes feature-point placement. Low values are more uniform/structured; higher values create more organic, irregular cells.

Flubs.Name: Metric Morph
Flubs.Description: Blends between the paired distance behaviors implied by the selected Distance Metric (e.g., Euclidian ↔ Manhattan/Chebyshev), changing cell geometry continuously.

Flubs.Name: Distance Metric
Flubs.Description: Selects the distance-space used to evaluate the cellular field, affecting the fundamental shape of cells and borders.

Flubs.Name: Euclidian_Manhattan
Flubs.Description: Morph between rounded Euclidian cells and diamond-like Manhattan cells (axis-aligned, sharper corners) using Metric Morph.

Flubs.Name: Euclidian_Chebyshev
Flubs.Description: Morph between rounded Euclidian cells and square-like Chebyshev cells using Metric Morph.

Flubs.Name: Minkowski
Flubs.Description: Generalized metric that spans a continuous family of distance shapes (useful for smoothly varying from rounded to more boxy forms).

Flubs.Name: Coordinate Axes Jitter
Flubs.Description: Adds jitter in coordinate/axis space before evaluation, warping the field and introducing directional wobble and boundary distortion.

Flubs.Name: CAJ Clustering
Flubs.Description: Controls how Coordinate Axes Jitter groups together. Low values spread distortion evenly; higher values create patchy/clumped distortion regions.

Flubs.Name: Anisotropy
Flubs.Description: Stretches the pattern directionally, producing elongated/elliptical cells and emphasizing a dominant direction.

Flubs.Name: Distance Function
Flubs.Description: Defines what value is output from the cellular field (cell IDs, distances to points, borders, or edges).

Flubs.Name: Hash
Flubs.Description: Outputs a stable random value per cell region (cell ID-style mask), useful for random patching, selection, and variation.

Flubs.Name: DistanceInv
Flubs.Description: Outputs inverse distance to the nearest feature point (bright centers fading toward borders).

Flubs.Name: Distance2Inv
Flubs.Description: Outputs inverse distance to the second-nearest feature point, producing a different internal falloff useful for variation and breakup.

Flubs.Name: DistanceDiff
Flubs.Description: Outputs the difference between nearest distances (classic Voronoi edge emphasis), great for ridges, veins, and cell borders.

Flubs.Name: DistanceToEdge
Flubs.Description: Outputs distance to the nearest cell border, ideal for crack networks and edge masks when remapped.

Flubs.Name: Seed
Flubs.Description: Changes the random distribution of feature points without changing other settings.

Name: Cellular3D
Description: Generates three-dimensional cellular noise useful for volumetric-looking patterns and complex terrain breakup.

Flubs.Name: Size
Flubs.Description: Controls the overall scale of the 3D cellular pattern. Higher values produce larger, more widely spaced cells.

Flubs.Name: Gap
Flubs.Description: Sets the distance or separation between individual cells, affecting the openness and density of the pattern.

Flubs.Name: Jitter X
Flubs.Description: Applies random offset to cell positions along the X axis, introducing irregularity and breaking uniformity.

Flubs.Name: Jitter Y
Flubs.Description: Applies random offset to cell positions along the Y axis, adding variation and natural randomness.

Flubs.Name: Jitter Z
Flubs.Description: Applies random offset to cell positions along the Z axis, further enhancing the organic appearance of the 3D pattern.

Flubs.Name: Scale X
Flubs.Description: Adjusts the scale of the cellular pattern along the X axis, stretching or compressing cells horizontally.

Flubs.Name: Scale Y
Flubs.Description: Adjusts the scale of the cellular pattern along the Y axis, stretching or compressing cells vertically.

Flubs.Name: Scale Z
Flubs.Description: Adjusts the scale of the cellular pattern along the Z axis, stretching or compressing cells in depth.

Flubs.Name: Seed
Flubs.Description: Randomization seed for generating unique variations of the 3D cellular pattern. Changing the seed produces different cell arrangements.

Flubs.Name: Normalize Input
Flubs.Description: If enabled, normalizes the input values to a standard range before applying the cellular pattern, ensuring consistent results regardless of input scale.

Name: Chokepoint
Description: 强调或塑造狭窄通道/咽喉地形。

Name: Clamp
Description: Clamp 控制地形高度：可压缩、在特定高度裁切，或用 Extend 拉高。

Flubs.Name: Mode
Flubs.Description: 限制数值所用的钳制方式。

Flubs.Name: Standard
Flubs.Description: 对输入施加固定最小/最大钳制。

Flubs.Name: Normalized
Flubs.Description: 钳制并重映射到归一化 0–1 范围。

Flubs.Name: Value
Flubs.Description: 钳制阈值/范围；超出部分被限制在边界。

Flubs.Name: Drop
Flubs.Description: 将整体形状降到最低值，即“放下”整个形体。

Name: Clip
Description: 裁切超出范围的数值。

Name: CLUTer
Description: 颜色查找表（CLUT）映射，用于风格化上色。

Flubs.Name: Reverse
Flubs.Description: Reverses the mapping of the gradient.

Name: ColorErosion
Description: 结合颜色通道的侵蚀/沉积染色效果。

Flubs.Name: V0
Flubs.Description: <desc>

Flubs.Name: V1
Flubs.Description: <desc>

Flubs.Name: V2
Flubs.Description: <desc>

Name: ColorThreshold
Description: Creates a greyscale mask from a specified color range.

Flubs.Name: Start
Flubs.Description: The color to mask from the given input.

Flubs.Name: Falloff
Flubs.Description: Range of similar colors to be masked as well.

Name: Combine
Description: Combine 是最重要的节点之一：用多种数学/混合模式合并两个地形（或任意输出）。

Flubs.Name: Ratio
Flubs.Description: 应用于所选混合方式的比例。

Flubs.Name: Mode
Flubs.Description: 混合模式。

Flubs.Name: Blend
Flubs.Description: 将源简单叠在底之上，无额外运算。

Flubs.Name: Add
Flubs.Description: 相加提亮：源加到底上。

Flubs.Name: Screen
Flubs.Description: 类似投影到屏幕的滤色提亮混合。

Flubs.Name: Subtract
Flubs.Description:
Darkens by subtracting the source from the base.
Base minus source per channel, clamps at zero.

Flubs.Name: Difference
Flubs.Description:
Emphasizes contrast by subtracting lower from higher values.
Absolute difference |A - B| for high-contrast edge-like results.

Flubs.Name: Multiply
Flubs.Description:
Darkens by multiplying source and base colors.
Channel-wise multiplication; A × B, darkens with stacking.

Flubs.Name: Divide
Flubs.Description:
Lightens by dividing base by source.
Base divided by source; A / B with normalization/scaling.

Flubs.Name: Divide2
Flubs.Description:
Alternative division with different scaling for smoother results.
Alternate divide with different scaling/offset to reduce clipping.

Flubs.Name: Max
Flubs.Description:
Keeps the brighter value at each pixel.
Channel-wise maximum; keeps highest of A and B.

Flubs.Name: Min
Flubs.Description:
Keeps the darker value at each pixel.
Channel-wise minimum; keeps lowest of A and B.

Flubs.Name: Hypotenuse
Flubs.Description:
Combines channels using geometric distance for soft blending.
sqrt(A² + B²); Euclidean combination for smooth, bright blend.

Flubs.Name: Overlay
Flubs.Description:
Combines multiply and screen for vivid contrast.
Combines Multiply and Screen based on base brightness.

Flubs.Name: Power
Flubs.Description:
Raises base to the power of source for nonlinear effects.
Raises base to source power; A ^ B per channel.

Flubs.Name: Exclusion
Flubs.Description:
Low-contrast version of Difference for softer inversion.
A + B - 2AB; softer Difference with reduced contrast.

Flubs.Name: Dodge
Flubs.Description:
Brightens highlights by dividing inverted base by inverted source.
A / (1 - B); brightens highlights aggressively.

Flubs.Name: Burn
Flubs.Description:
Darkens shadows by inverting, dividing, and inverting again.
1 - (1 - A) / B; intensifies shadows via division.

Flubs.Name: SoftLight
Flubs.Description:
Gently lightens or darkens based on source brightness.
Conditional blend approximating diffused light on surface.

Flubs.Name: HardLight
Flubs.Description:
Strong contrast blend combining multiply and screen.

Flubs.Name: Duration
Flubs.Description: Controls how long the simulation runs. Longer durations produce stronger and more extensive crumbling effects.

Flubs.Name: Strength
Flubs.Description: Defines how intensely the rock or terrain breaks apart from the main body. Higher values result in more aggressive fragmentation.

Flubs.Name: Coverage
Flubs.Description: Sets how far the crumbling effect spreads inward from exposed edges, determining the affected area.

Flubs.Name: Horizontal
Flubs.Description: Biases the crumble effect towards flow origins or towards deposits, influencing the lateral direction of collapse.

Flubs.Name: Vertical
Flubs.Description: Biases the crumble effect towards higher or lower altitudes, controlling whether upper or lower terrain is more affected.

Flubs.Name: Rock Hardness
Flubs.Description: Controls material resistance, reducing how much terrain collapses. Higher values simulate harder, more resilient rock.

Flubs.Name: Edge
Flubs.Description: Expands or reduces the impact of crumbling specifically on sharp terrain edges, allowing for more pronounced or subdued edge effects.

Flubs.Name: Downcutting
Flubs.Description: Controls how deeply the simulation carves downward into the terrain during crumbling, affecting the vertical extent of collapse.

Flubs.Name: Depth
Flubs.Description: Adjusts the overall depth of the collapsed areas, determining how far the terrain sinks or breaks away.

Flubs.Name: Direction
Flubs.Description: Specifies the primary direction in which the crumbling effect propagates across the terrain.

Flubs.Name: X

Flubs.Name: N

Flubs.Name: E

Flubs.Name: S

Flubs.Name: W
Flubs.Description: Directs the crumbling effect towards the west (left in world space).

Name: Curvature
Description: Curvature creates a mask where convex areas (protrusions, sharp edges, etc.) are selected. Very useful layer in texture creation, often as highlights on top of an existing texture map.

Flubs.Name: Range
Flubs.Description: Sets the minimum and maximum curvature values to include in the mask. Only terrain features within this curvature range are selected.

Flubs.Name: Type
Flubs.Description: Specifies the type of curvature to evaluate for the mask, determining which terrain features are highlighted.

Flubs.Name: Horizontal
Flubs.Description: Selects areas with horizontal (planform) curvature, highlighting ridges and valleys based on their plan shape.

Flubs.Name: Vertical
Flubs.Description: Selects areas with vertical (profile) curvature, emphasizing convex and concave slopes along the direction of steepest descent.

Flubs.Name: Average
Flubs.Description: Uses the average of horizontal and vertical curvature, providing a balanced mask that highlights both plan and profile features.

Flubs.Name: Falloff
Flubs.Description: Controls the softness of the mask transition at the range boundaries. Higher values create a smoother, more gradual blend from selected to unselected areas.

Name: Curve
Description: Curve adjusts the height curve of a terrain.

Flubs.Name: Curve Spline
Flubs.Description: Defines the shape of the curve or spline used to remap or adjust values. The curve controls how input values are transformed, allowing for custom response profiles or non-linear adjustments.

Flubs.Name: Mode
Flubs.Description: Specifies how the curve is applied to the input values.

Flubs.Name: Absolute
Flubs.Description: Applies the curve using absolute input values, mapping the entire range directly according to the curve shape.

Flubs.Name: Relative
Flubs.Description: Applies the curve relative to the input's current range or context, allowing for adaptive or proportional remapping.

Flubs.Name: Fit Curve

Flubs.Name: Sharp

Flubs.Name: Distribution
Flubs.Description: Specifies how debris is distributed across the emission area.

Flubs.Name: Uniform

Name: Deflate
Description: Compresses and pulls terrain features inward, reducing bulk and prominence.

Flubs.Name: Amount
Flubs.Description: Controls the degree to which the terrain is compressed or lowered. Higher values result in a more pronounced flattening or reduction of elevation, effectively 'deflating' the terrain features.

Name: Denoise
Description: Denoise is a general purpose noise removal filter that systematically cleans up random noise, spikes, and extremely sharp edges.

Flubs.Name: Type
Flubs.Description: Selects the denoising method used to smooth noise while preserving overall features.

Flubs.Name: OnePass
Flubs.Description: Runs a single denoise pass for fast, moderate smoothing.

Flubs.Name: TwoPass
Flubs.Description: Runs a stronger two-stage denoise for cleaner results with better feature retention.

Flubs.Name: Pixels
Flubs.Description: Targets pixel-level speckle and stair-stepping artifacts, focusing on discrete noisy pixels.

Flubs.Name: Amount
Flubs.Description: Strength of the denoising effect (higher values smooth more, but can soften detail).

Flubs.Name: Passes
Flubs.Description: Number of denoise iterations to apply for the selected method.

Name: Dilate
Description: Dilate the pixels of the heightfield or mask.

Flubs.Name: Size
Flubs.Description: Sets the size of the dilation effect. Larger values expand features more, increasing the reach of the dilation.

Flubs.Name: Shape
Flubs.Description: Specifies the geometric shape used for the dilation operation, affecting how features are expanded.

Flubs.Name: Iterations
Flubs.Description: Controls how many times the dilation process is repeated. More iterations result in greater expansion of features.

Flubs.Name: Kernel
Flubs.Description: Selects the kernel type used for dilation, determining the pattern and direction of expansion.

Flubs.Name: Cross
Flubs.Description: Uses a cross-shaped kernel, expanding features in horizontal and vertical directions.

Flubs.Name: Rectangle
Flubs.Description: Uses a rectangular kernel, expanding features uniformly in all directions.

Flubs.Name: Line
Flubs.Description: Uses a line-shaped kernel, expanding features along a specified direction.

Flubs.Name: LineVertical
Flubs.Description: Uses a vertical line kernel, expanding features only in the vertical direction.

Flubs.Name: Invert
Flubs.Description: Inverts the input before applying dilation, causing the operation to expand background areas instead of foreground features.

Flubs.Name: Classic
Flubs.Description: Uses the standard distance calculation method, suitable for most general purposes.

Flubs.Name: RT
Flubs.Description: Uses a real-time optimized distance calculation, providing faster results for interactive workflows.

Flubs.Name: Mode
Flubs.Description: Determines the pattern or structure of the distance calculation, affecting how distance propagates from the source.

Flubs.Name: Asterisk
Flubs.Description: Calculates distance in a star-shaped (asterisk) pattern, radiating out in multiple directions.

Flubs.Name: Pyramid
Flubs.Description: Calculates distance in a pyramid or diamond pattern, emphasizing diagonal and orthogonal propagation.

Flubs.Name: Directions
Flubs.Description: Sets the number of directions in which distance is calculated, influencing the angular resolution and smoothness of the result.

Flubs.Name: Skew
Flubs.Description: Applies a skew or bias to the distance field, distorting the propagation direction for creative or technical effects.

Flubs.Name: Angle
Flubs.Description: Specifies the primary angle or orientation for directional distance calculations, allowing for anisotropic effects.

Flubs.Name: Angular Jitter
Flubs.Description: Introduces randomness to the angle of distance propagation, creating more organic and less uniform distance fields.

Flubs.Name: Falloff
Flubs.Description: Controls how quickly the distance value decreases with increasing distance from the source, shaping the gradient of the field.

Flubs.Name: Threshold
Flubs.Description: Sets a cutoff value for the distance field. Values beyond this threshold are clamped or ignored.

Flubs.Name: Falloff Jitter
Flubs.Description: Adds randomness to the falloff rate, producing irregular or natural-looking distance gradients.

Flubs.Name: Options
Flubs.Description: Inverts the input mask or field before calculating distance, reversing the source and background.

Flubs.Name: Invert Input
Flubs.Description: Inverts the input mask or field before calculating distance, reversing the source and background.

Flubs.Name: Invert Output
Flubs.Description: Inverts the resulting distance field, swapping near and far values.

Flubs.Name: Multiply by Input
Flubs.Description: Multiplies the final distance field by the original input, masking or modulating the result.

Flubs.Name: Seed
Flubs.Description: Randomization seed for any stochastic elements in the distance calculation, ensuring reproducible or varied results.

Flubs.Name: Dot
Flubs.Description: Generates round blobs or spheres, creating soft, circular noise patterns.

Flubs.Name: Square
Flubs.Description: Generates square-shaped blobs, resulting in blocky, grid-like noise patterns.

Flubs.Name: Iterations
Flubs.Description: Sets the number of times dots or blobs are placed on the surface. Higher values increase the density and coverage of the noise.

Flubs.Name: Multiplier
Flubs.Description: Scales the intensity or strength of the dot noise effect, amplifying the contribution of each blob.

Flubs.Name: Size
Flubs.Description: Controls the average size of each dot, blob, or sphere. Larger values produce bigger features.

Flubs.Name: Height
Flubs.Description: Sets the maximum elevation or intensity of the dots or blobs above the base surface.

Flubs.Name: Blend Mode
Flubs.Description: Determines how the dot noise is combined with the underlying surface or input.

Flubs.Description: No blending is applied; the dot noise is used as-is.

Flubs.Name: Blend
Flubs.Description: Blends the dot noise with the input using standard alpha or linear blending.

Flubs.Name: Add
Flubs.Description: Adds the dot noise values to the input, increasing elevation or intensity where dots are present.

Flubs.Name: Subtract
Flubs.Description: Subtracts the dot noise from the input, creating depressions or pits where dots are placed.

Flubs.Name: Difference
Flubs.Description: Applies a difference operation, emphasizing areas where the dot noise and input differ.

Flubs.Name: Multiply
Flubs.Description: Multiplies the dot noise with the input, modulating the surface based on dot presence.

Flubs.Name: Screen
Flubs.Description: Uses a screen blend, lightening the surface where dots are present.

Flubs.Name: Max
Flubs.Description: Takes the maximum value between the dot noise and the input at each point.

Flubs.Name: Min
Flubs.Description: Takes the minimum value between the dot noise and the input at each point.

Flubs.Description: Randomization seed for dot placement and variation. Changing the seed produces different dot patterns.

Flubs.Description: Sets the strength of fluvial erosion, controlling the sediment transport capacity. Higher values allow water to carry more dissolved minerals, increasing the rate and impact of erosion.

Flubs.Name: Downcutting
Flubs.Description: Group containing parameters related to the vertical erosion process, where water cuts down into the terrain to form channels and valleys.

Flubs.Name: Downcutting
Flubs.Description: Group containing parameters related to the vertical erosion process, where water cuts down into the terrain to form channels and valleys.

Flubs.Name: Inhibition
Flubs.Description: Adds restraints to the downcutting process by slowing it down when undissolved sediments accumulate. This results in a mix of deep channels and alluvial fans, depending on local conditions.

Flubs.Name: Base Level
Flubs.Description: Sets the lowest elevation that downcutting can reach before sediment is deposited. This helps fill large valleys and form valley floors, influenced by terrain slope, altitude, and stream velocity.

Flubs.Name: Scale
Flubs.Description: Determines the lateral size of the largest erosion features, such as the width of major valleys and ridges, measured in meters.

Flubs.Name: Feature Scale
Flubs.Description: Determines the lateral size of the largest erosion features, such as the width of major valleys and ridges, measured in meters.

Flubs.Name: Real Scale
Flubs.Description: Automatically determines the scale from the Terrain Definition, ensuring erosion features are sized appropriately for the terrain.

Flubs.Name: Terrain Scale
Flubs.Description: Sets the simulated scale of the entire terrain width. Available when Rivers is enabled, this parameter helps match erosion to real-world dimensions.

Flubs.Name: Verticality
Flubs.Description: Sets the simulated height of the entire terrain. Available when Rivers is enabled, this parameter controls the vertical exaggeration of erosion features.

Flubs.Name: Flow
Flubs.Description: Controls the amount and behavior of debris generated and transported during the erosion process.

Flubs.Name: Debris
Flubs.Description: Controls the amount and behavior of debris generated and transported during the erosion process.

Flubs.Name: Volume
Flubs.Description: Alters erosion physics to treat water flows as volumetric, resulting in higher water levels, wider channels, and more extensive sediment deposits. Useful for forming valley floors without downcutting.

Flubs.Name: Sediment Removal
Flubs.Description: Removes sediment produced during erosion. This can be modulated using the Sediment Removal mask input to control where sediment is retained or cleared.

Flubs.Name: Selective Processing
Flubs.Description: Specifies the effect applied when an Area input or Bias is defined. Determines which erosion property is selectively processed.

Flubs.Name: Area Effect
Flubs.Description: Specifies the effect applied when an Area input or Bias is defined. Determines which erosion property is selectively processed.

Flubs.Name: ErosionStrength
Flubs.Description: Applies selective processing to the erosion strength, allowing targeted control over erosion intensity.

Flubs.Name: RockSoftness
Flubs.Description: Applies selective processing to rock softness, enabling localized variation in erosion rates.

Flubs.Name: PrecipitationAmount
Flubs.Description: Applies selective processing to precipitation amount, affecting how much water is available for erosion in specific areas.

Flubs.Name: None
Flubs.Description: No selective processing is applied; erosion is uniform across the terrain.

Flubs.Name: Bias Type
Flubs.Description: Specifies the type of automatic bias to apply when an Area input is not provided. Determines how erosion is distributed based on terrain features.

Flubs.Name: Altitude
Flubs.Description: Applies bias based on elevation, allowing erosion to be stronger or weaker at different heights.

Flubs.Name: Slope
Flubs.Description: Applies bias based on terrain slope, enabling more erosion on steeper or flatter areas.

Flubs.Name: Bias
Flubs.Description: Sets the strength of the bias. For Slope, this controls the steepness threshold; for Altitude, it sets the position from the bottom of the terrain.

Flubs.Name: Reverse

Flubs.Name: Aggressive Mode

Flubs.Name: Deterministic
Flubs.Description: Ensures the erosion simulation produces the same result every time with the same input and seed, improving reproducibility.

Flubs.Name: HighPass

Flubs.Name: LowShelf
Flubs.Description: Boosts or cuts low frequencies while leaving higher frequencies mostly unchanged.

Flubs.Name: HighShelf
Flubs.Description: Boosts or cuts high frequencies while leaving lower frequencies mostly unchanged.

Flubs.Name: Seed
Flubs.Description: Randomization seed for the node's process. Changing the seed produces different terrace arrangements.

Flubs.Name: Shapes separation

Flubs.Name: Macro octaves

Flubs.Name: Micro shape

Flubs.Name: Character

Flubs.Name: Thickness uniformity

Flubs.Name: Hardness uniformity

Flubs.Name: Protect Range

Flubs.Name: Layers
Flubs.Description: Sets the number of distinct ice layers, allowing for multi-layered ice formations and increased visual complexity.

Flubs.Name: Thickness
Flubs.Description: Specifies the vertical thickness of the ice floes, determining how prominent or deep the ice appears.

Flubs.Name: Shaper 1
Flubs.Description: Applies the first shaping function or modifier to the ice floes, affecting their outline and internal structure.

Flubs.Name: Shaper 2
Flubs.Description: Applies a secondary shaping function or modifier, allowing for additional variation and detail in the ice floes.

Flubs.Name: Reverse
Flubs.Description: Inverts the effect of the primary shaping function, altering the distribution or orientation of the ice floes.

Flubs.Name: Reverse 2
Flubs.Description: Inverts the effect of the secondary shaping function, providing further control over the appearance of the ice floes.

Flubs.Name: Seed
Flubs.Description: The randomization pattern or seed for the node's process. Changing the seed produces different ice floe arrangements.

Name: Island
Description: Island draws basic shapes from which entire landmasses can be generated.

Flubs.Name: Seed

Name: Lake
Description: Lake simulates rainfall on the terrain and creates physically accurate lakes.

Flubs.Name: Lake Formation

Flubs.Name: Y

Flubs.Name: Water Level
Flubs.Description: Level of the water.

Flubs.Name: Render Surface
Flubs.Description: Whether to render the surface of the water or just create masks.

Flubs.Name: Accuracy
Flubs.Description: The accuracy of the water placement and water containment within depressions.

Flubs.Name: Precipitation
Flubs.Description: Controls the amount of water available for lake formation, influencing the size and number of lakes generated.

Flubs.Name: Small Lakes
Flubs.Description: Enables or adjusts the creation of smaller lakes, increasing the frequency of minor water bodies across the terrain.

Flubs.Name: Flood Control
Flubs.Description: Limits excessive flooding by managing water distribution, preventing lakes from overflowing or merging unnaturally.

Flubs.Name: Water Floor
Flubs.Description: Sets the elevation of the lake bed, determining the minimum depth and base level of the water body.

Flubs.Name: Shore Formation
Flubs.Description: Controls the width and extent of the shoreline around lakes, affecting how far the shore transitions into the surrounding terrain.

Flubs.Name: Shore Size
Flubs.Description: Controls the width and extent of the shoreline around lakes, affecting how far the shore transitions into the surrounding terrain.

Flubs.Name: Altitude Bias
Flubs.Description: Biases lake placement towards certain altitudes, favoring higher or lower terrain for lake formation.

Flubs.Name: Size Bias
Flubs.Description: Adjusts the likelihood of generating larger or smaller lakes, influencing the overall distribution of lake sizes.

Name: Layers
Description: Combines multiple layers using blend operations in a stacked workflow.

Name: Lichtenberg
Description: Creates branching, lightning-like erosion or fracture patterns.

Flubs.Name: Style
Flubs.Description: Selects the style for the cracks, determining the overall appearance and pattern of the Lichtenberg figures.

Flubs.Name: A
Flubs.Description: Style A: Produces a classic branching crack pattern, suitable for general terrain fracturing.

Flubs.Name: B
Flubs.Description: Style B: Generates a denser, more intricate crack network for detailed surface effects.

Flubs.Name: C
Flubs.Description: Style C: Creates a sparse, wide-spread crack pattern, ideal for subtle terrain disruption.

Flubs.Name: Scale
Flubs.Description: Controls the scale of the larger cracks, affecting how prominent and wide the main crack structures appear.

Flubs.Name: Complexity
Flubs.Description: Adjusts the level of detail in the crack network. Higher values produce more branches and finer crack structures.

Flubs.Name: Depth
Flubs.Description: Sets the depth of the cracks, determining how deeply the cracks cut into the terrain surface.

Flubs.Name: Expand
Flubs.Description: Expands the cracks outward, increasing their coverage and making the crack network more pronounced.

Flubs.Name: Bias
Flubs.Description: Provides artistic control over the shape and direction of the cracks, allowing for customized crack patterns.

Flubs.Name: Seed
Flubs.Description: Random seed for generating the crack pattern. Changing the seed produces different crack arrangements while keeping other settings the same.

Name: LightX
Description: Creates a fully lit render using controllable sun, shadow, and ambient lighting.

Flubs.Name: Direction Selection
Flubs.Description: Specifies how the sun direction is determined for lighting calculations.

Flubs.Name: Manual
Flubs.Description: Allows manual input of sun direction parameters such as azimuth and elevation.

Flubs.Name: Geographic
Flubs.Description: Calculates sun direction based on geographic coordinates, date, and time for physically accurate lighting.

Flubs.Name: North
Flubs.Description: Sets the orientation of the north direction in the scene, affecting geographic sun calculations.

Flubs.Name: Latitude
Flubs.Description: Specifies the latitude for geographic sun calculations, influencing sun position and lighting angle.

Flubs.Name: Day of Year
Flubs.Description: Sets the day of the year for geographic sun calculations, affecting seasonal sun position and lighting.

Flubs.Name: Solar Hour
Flubs.Description: Specifies the time of day for geographic sun calculations, determining the sun's position in the sky.

Flubs.Name: Sun Azimuth
Flubs.Description: Sets the horizontal angle of the sun, determining the direction from which sunlight is cast.

Flubs.Name: Sun Elevation
Flubs.Description: Controls the vertical angle of the sun above the horizon, affecting the length and intensity of shadows.

Flubs.Name: Angular Diameter
Flubs.Description: Specifies the apparent size of the sun in the sky, influencing the softness of shadows and highlights.

Flubs.Name: Direct Light
Flubs.Description: Adjusts the intensity of direct sunlight in the scene, affecting brightness and shadow contrast.

Flubs.Name: Shadows
Flubs.Description: Enables or adjusts the rendering of shadows cast by terrain features, enhancing depth and realism.

Flubs.Name: Ambient Light
Flubs.Description: Controls the overall ambient light level, simulating indirect illumination from the sky and environment.

Flubs.Name: Ambient Occlusion
Flubs.Description: Enables or adjusts ambient occlusion, which darkens crevices and areas shielded from ambient light for added realism.

Flubs.Name: Quality
Flubs.Description: Sets the rendering quality for lighting and shadow calculations.

Flubs.Name: Low
Flubs.Description: Fastest rendering with basic lighting and shadow detail.

Flubs.Name: Medium
Flubs.Description: Balanced quality and performance with moderate lighting and shadow detail.

Flubs.Name: High
Flubs.Description: High-quality rendering with detailed lighting and shadows.

Flubs.Name: Ultra
Flubs.Description: Maximum quality with the most accurate lighting and shadow effects.

Flubs.Name: Light
Flubs.Description: Adjusts the exposure level, controlling the overall brightness and dynamic range of the rendered image.

Flubs.Name: Exposure
Flubs.Description: Adjusts the exposure level, controlling the overall brightness and dynamic range of the rendered image.

Flubs.Name: Sun Intensity
Flubs.Description: Sets the strength of the sun's light, affecting the brightness of direct illumination.

Flubs.Name: Ambient Intensity
Flubs.Description: Controls the strength of ambient light, influencing the brightness of areas not directly lit by the sun.

Flubs.Name: Air Density
Flubs.Description: Simulates atmospheric density, affecting the scattering of light and the appearance of haze.

Flubs.Name: Haze
Flubs.Description: Adds atmospheric haze to the scene, softening distant terrain and simulating light diffusion.

Flubs.Name: Ozone
Flubs.Description: Adjusts the ozone level in the atmosphere, influencing the color and intensity of sunlight.

Flubs.Name: Colors
Flubs.Description: Enables automatic adjustment of sun and ambient colors based on sun position and atmospheric conditions.

Flubs.Name: Automatic Colors
Flubs.Description: Enables automatic adjustment of sun and ambient colors based on sun position and atmospheric conditions.

Flubs.Name: Sun Color
Flubs.Description: Sets the color of direct sunlight, allowing for warm, cool, or custom lighting effects.

Flubs.Name: Ambient Color
Flubs.Description: Specifies the color of ambient light, affecting the overall tone of shaded areas.

Flubs.Name: Ground Brightness
Flubs.Description: Controls the brightness of the ground plane, influencing the overall illumination and visual balance of the scene.

Name: MacroPort
Description: Defines an input or output port inside a macro for passing height, mask, or color data.

Flubs.Name: Direction
Flubs.Description: Specifies whether the macro port is used for input or output connections. Determines the flow of data into or out of the macro node.

Flubs.Name: Input
Flubs.Description: Designates the port as an input, allowing data to be received by the macro node.

Flubs.Name: Output
Flubs.Description: Designates the port as an output, allowing data to be sent from the macro node.

Flubs.Name: Display
Flubs.Description: Defines the type of data visualized or represented by the macro port. This helps users identify the nature of the connection in the node graph.

Flubs.Name: Heightfield
Flubs.Description: Represents terrain elevation data, typically used for heightmaps.

Flubs.Name: Mask
Flubs.Description: Represents mask data, used for isolating or selecting specific regions in the terrain.

Flubs.Name: Color
Flubs.Description: Represents color data, used for visual effects or texture information.

Flubs.Name: Fallback
Flubs.Description: When the given input fails or is intended to short-circuit, return the selected map.

Flubs.Name: Null
Flubs.Description: Return a null value. May cause node to be disrupted, but needed for Switch and other mechanisms.

Flubs.Name: Black
Flubs.Description: A black (0) value map.

Flubs.Name: White
Flubs.Description: A white (1) value map.

Flubs.Name: Grey

Name: Mask
Description: Mask draws a mask. If the Input port is connected to another node, a 2D representation of that terrain is shown in the background as a guide. This is optional, as the Input port only provides a drawing guide and does not affect the actual mask.

Name: Match
Description: Matches the height range or histogram of one terrain to another.

Flubs.Name: Mode
Flubs.Description: Specifies the method used to match the height of the current terrain to a reference terrain. Determines how the height adjustment is performed.

Flubs.Name: Height
Flubs.Description: Directly matches the height values of the current terrain to the reference terrain, aligning elevation point-for-point.

Flubs.Name: Histogram
Flubs.Description: Matches the height distribution (histogram) of the current terrain to that of the reference terrain, preserving relative features while adjusting overall elevation statistics.

Name: MathX
Description: Evaluates mathematical expressions to generate or modify terrain data procedurally.

Flubs.Name: Expression
Flubs.Description: Math expression or program to execute.

Flubs.Name: Open Editor
Flubs.Description: Opens the Math Editor dialog.

Flubs.Name: Normalized Coordinates
Flubs.Description: Normalizes all coordinate inputs.

Description: Applies a median filter to remove spikes, speckles, and small noise while preserving edges better than blur.
